title: Read association output

blocks.what_we_do: Identify effect allele, sample count, uncertainty, test type and fitting status.
blocks.why: A1 is the allele whose dosage is tested, not automatically ALT, minor or harmful. OR estimates its multiplicative effect on odds. OBS_CT is the number of samples used at that variant and may vary with missing calls. ERRCODE describes model failures; a missing p-value must remain missing. A 95% confidence interval is exp(log(OR) +/- 1.96 * SE) under the fitted approximation. The interval describes estimation uncertainty under assumptions, not the chance this single interval contains a fixed truth.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-5}
results <- guided_association(guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "association"))
print(table(results$ERRCODE, useNA = "ifany"))
valid <- results[valid_p(results$P), ]
valid$CI_LOW <- exp(log(valid$OR) - 1.96 * valid[["LOG(OR)_SE"]])
valid$CI_HIGH <- exp(log(valid$OR) + 1.96 * valid[["LOG(OR)_SE"]])
top <- valid[order(valid$P), c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "A1", "OBS_CT", "OR", "CI_LOW", "CI_HIGH", "P")]
print(head(top, 10))
guided_write(head(top, 20), guided_path(cfg, "6.5", "top20.tsv"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.5", guided_path(cfg, "6.5", "top20.tsv"), parent = "6.4")
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
The leading regions are on chromosomes 9, 3 and 12. The table preserves the effect allele and variant-specific OBS_CT. P-values and ORs refer to the tested A1 allele, regardless of how the identifier was constructed.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the instructor reference.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
What should you do with a row whose ERRCODE indicates failure and whose p-value is missing?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Inspect its failure reason and retain it as missing; do not replace it with a significant or non-significant numerical value.

</details>
